news.headline: Atos and Microsoft Extend Partnership for Digital Sovereignty
news.summary: Atos and Microsoft have expanded their collaboration to provide public sector and regulated organizations with digital environments that meet specific sovereignty, resilience, and compliance requirements.

news.headline: V2X Expands Collaboration with Microsoft to Advance AI-Powered Mission Operations
news.summary: V2X, Inc. has expanded its collaboration with Microsoft to integrate Microsoft Foundry and Microsoft Fabric into its mission operations, aiming to accelerate innovation in defense and national security.

news.headline: Microsoft UAE and Space42 Release Report on Geospatial Agentic AI
news.summary: Microsoft UAE and Space42 have published a joint report exploring the potential of Geospatial Agentic AI to assist governments in operationalizing intelligence for public services.
